{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Lobereki-LostFound.png]] |name=Lobereki |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Duraceph]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]] |skin=[[Color|Blue]] and tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Listen3|LoberekiGrunt-LostFound.flac|Lobereki grunting and exclaiming|Finding his blaster stuck in its holster, Lobereki grunts and exclaims}} '''Lobereki''' was a [[Duraceph]] [[courier]] with a fast [[starship]] who was active during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], he and a group of other locals dined with [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]—whom he considered somewhat attractive for a non-Duraceph—in the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]] on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]]. As they [[Diet|ate]], the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] approached and [[Mae's quest|demanded]] that Indara attack her. Lobereki and the other locals initially laughed at Aniseya, but when the [[Jedi]] declined to fight, the [[assassin]] instead attacked her companions. The Duraceph fought against her in return but, after his [[blaster]] stuck in its [[holster]], Aniseya kicked a table into the courier and knocked him out. She then [[Indara's murder|killed]] Indara and left. ==Biography== ===Dinner with a Jedi=== {{Quote|Master Indara.''"
"''Yes, my child?''"
"''We have unfinished business. Attack me with all your strength.''"
[Lobereki and others laugh]|quoteend=0|Mae-ho Aniseya confronts Indara|audio=Mae-Indara-AttackMe-LostFound.flac|{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}}} [[File:Pilga-Lobereki-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=The human Dyn Pilga, wearing a fur cap, and the blue-skinned Duraceph Lobereki sit at a table in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.|Lobereki dined with Indara and other locals at the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.]] Lobereki was a [[Duraceph]] who worked as a [[courier]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Local to [[Point Ueda]], the [[capital]] of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]], he traveled frequently and so was kept well-informed of any nearby incidents that were worth reporting to the [[human]] [[Indara]], a [[Jedi Master]] stationed on Ueda. Indara preferred hearing unvarnished truths and agenda-free reports from locals like Lobereki than from the [[Politics|planetary leaders]], [[marshal]]s, and civic representatives that she dealt with in a [[diplomat]]ic capacity. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Lobereki dined with Indara and a group of three other locals—[[Ohal Alond]], [[Dyn Pilga]], and [[Tianris Mez]]—at a table in the back corner{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}} of the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in Point Ueda. As they [[Diet|ate]], the hooded [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] approached the table and addressed Indara, claiming they had [[Mae's quest|unfinished business]]. Lowering herself into a fighting stance, Aniseya demanded the [[Jedi]] attack her, but after a moment of stunned silence, Mez began to laugh and Lobereki and the other locals joined in. ===The tables turn=== {{Listen3|LoberekiPunched-LostFound.flac|Lobereki grunting|Lobereki grunts as he is hit repeatedly by Mae-ho Aniseya}} Indara silenced the group with a raised [[Limb|hand]] and declined to fight the [[assassin]], so Aniseya instead attacked and incapacitated Alond before knocking Mez out when he tried to intervene. Moving around the table, Lobereki grabbed at Aniseya, but she dodged him and [[Unarmed combat|punched]] Pilga in the [[stomach]] while dodging a punch from him in return. Lobereki then missed again with a kick before Aniseya rammed her elbow into his neck and punched him in the face. She then hurled him across a table in the center of the room. When Lobereki stood, the assassin had Pilga in a head lock, so the Duraceph reached for his [[blaster]] but found it stuck in its [[holster]]. [[File:LoberekiShoots-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Lobereki stands with a blaster pointing at an upended table where a recently fired blaster shot explodes on the surface.|Lobereki got one shot off at Mae-ho Aniseya before she knocked him out.]] By the [[time]] he got it free, Aniseya had thrown Pilga to the ground and flipped a table up in front of her to shield herself from Lobereki's first shot. She then kicked the entire upended table into the courier, trapping him against another table and knocking him out. With her dining companions all incapacitated, Indara confronted Aniseya, but after a lengthy fight the assassin [[Indara's murder|killed]] the Jedi and then left. The [[Jedi Order]] then investigated the incident. ==Personality and traits== [[File:LoberekisBlaster-AcolyteVG.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A short blaster with a black barrel and trigger and a brown handle.|Lobereki rarely used his blaster.]] Lobereki admired Indara greatly and considered her somewhat attractive for a non-Duraceph. He had [[Color|blue]] and tan skin and yellow [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Lobereki [[Pilot|owned]] a fast [[starship]] and carried a blaster with an oversized [[power cell]], a black [[barrel]] and trigger, and a brown handle. Although he kept the cell charged, the courier rarely used the [[weapon]], and it tended to stick in the holster on the gray [[belt]] he wore with a set of gray [[robe]]s. He also wore metallic adornments and brown straps on his horns. ==Behind the scenes== Lobereki first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Prior to the release of the episode, Lobereki was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} Costume concept illustrator [[Sophie Fretwell]] created a design for Lobereki titled "Costume Concept for Handlebar Patron" and creature concept designer and sculptor [[Stefano Cordioli]] created piece titled "Handlebar Patron" that showed the alien as more hunched.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' Creatures effects artist [[Robert Skene]] worked on the mould for Lobereki as part of [[Neal Scanlan]]'s team.{{Instagram|username=robskenefx|url=p/C9sKJa6oOFo|name=[[Robert Skene]]|date=2024-07-21|quote=Now that Acolyte has finished, here are just a few of the characters I was involved with bringing to life. Everything was a huge team effort with everyone at CFX, and it was a dream come true, getting to be a part of it. My contribution varied from character to character, including clay walling, matrix molds, drafting cores, processing 3d printed molds, molding prosthetics and more, working alongside the fantastic team in Moldshop under Kenny Wilson. #starwars #theacolyte #cfx #creaturecantina #moldmaking #mouldmaking|archivefile=File:RobertSkene-Lobereki-Instagram.png}} The scenes in the noodle shop were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Lobereki was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:SophieFretwell-Lobereki-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|"Costume Concept for Handlebar Patron" by [[Sophie Fretwell]] File:StefanoCordioli-Lobereki-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|"Handlebar Patron" by [[Stefano Cordioli]] |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Lobereki|imagecat=Images of Lobereki}} *{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|zotV8szyesw|The Acolyte | Creating the Acolyte | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|7Dju63U24m0|The Acolyte | Crafting the Combat | Streaming Tuesday on Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|gBk-okerzAo|The Acolyte | Stunts | Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-creature-shop-bazil-reveal|text=Inside ''The Acolyte'' Creature Shop: Meet Bazil, the Tynnan Tracker -
